items.text: Tennessee traded All-Pro DT Jeffery Simmons to Chicago; he will not play for the Titans.

Tennessee (final report): OUT: RB Tyjae Spears (knee), WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), P Tommy Townsend (knee). QUESTIONABLE: DL John Franklin-Myers (groin), CB Jaylon Jones, LB Dorian Mausi, WR Calvin Ridley (hip, full Friday). Cam Ward is not on the report.

Cincinnati (final report): OUT: S Kyle Dugger (quad). QUESTIONABLE: LB Joe Giles-Harris (calf). Ja'Marr Chase and S Jordan Battle have no designation; DLs Dexter Lawrence, Jonathan Allen and B.J. Hill sat Friday but carry no designation. TEs Erick All Jr. and Tanner Hudson and WR Andrei Iosivas are on IR.
